note: The draw (fog) distance by region, in local units: with Options > Video > Fog distance auto on (the default) the game uses the row of the region the player is in, and the universal value everywhere else; the player's own value applies everywhere once Auto is off. Regions by the game's own region ids (case folded). A row in state trial applies only with the setting aw_fog_region_trial on (off by default): it waits for the frame rate measured on real hardware and the maintainer's decision; state default applies in every image. tools/region_draw.py writes world/region-draw.txt at the image step; the engine is engine/aga/src/aw_fog.c (REGIONAL-DRAW-DISTANCE-68). The CHIM world's own visibility reach is 540, so a row up to 540 needs no world rebuild.
